QuestInfo.name: Find the missing Job Instructor
QuestInfo.0: #p2151002#, the Wild Hunter instructor, lost contact during a recent mission, but you don't know anything else... Ask #b#p2151003##k for more information.
QuestInfo.1:
You are told that #p2151002# lost contact while he was on a mission to find out about the new Black Wings weapon being developed. Although there is no doubt that she infiltrated the laboratory, there is no way to know what happened next. Fortunately, you have a lock on #p2151002#'s signal. Find and enter the hidden Laboratory entrance in #b#m310060220##k.

* If you fail to proceed with the quest, forfeit and start over.
QuestInfo.2: You found #p2151002# inside the laboratory prison. She's injured and immobile, but thankfully still conscious...

0.0: We got word that the mad scientist #p2154009# was creating a new weapon for the Black Wings. #p2151002#'s mission was to investigate that weapon.
0.1: I know for sure that #p2151002# successfully entered the Mine after disguising herself as a Black Wing. She even got into the Laboratory where the new weapon is being developed. But we lost all contact with her shortly after that.
0.2: We never thought someone as skilled as #p2151002# could disappear like she did. But we can't sit here and do nothing! We must find her. That's where you come in...

yes.0: I won't lie to you. This mission won't be easy. It could even cost you your very life... But I think you're the only one who can rescue #p2151002#.
yes.1: What I just gave you is a #t4032740# that allows you to return to our Underground Base. It's valuable and we don't hand them out often, but this is an emergency. Find #p2151002# and use this to return to us.
yes.2: Like #p2151002#, you should #bdisguise yourself as a Black Wing to enter the Mine and approach #p2154009##k to find out which lab the weapon's being developed in. Once there, you should be able to track down #p2151002#... Good luck!\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Yes, I understand your fear. If even #p2151002#, your own job instructor, couldn't finish the mission... But I have confidence in you!

1.0: (You hear a snarl.) \r\nWho's there?! Show yourself! Wait, is that #h0#? #h0#! You're here to rescue me? I suppose now isn't the time to express my shame in needing to be rescued...

yes.0: Cough, cough! Huff, huff! Give me a moment to pull myself together.

npc.0:
Haven't you gone to the mine to find #p2151002# yet? I can explain it again if you're confused about the plan. 

#b* If you fail to proceed with the quest, forfeit and start over.
